source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Thank you, Nadia—the same to you! After reviewing the current proposal, I found that the full document totals 126 pages, including all letters, forms, and other materials. Of those 126 pages, 74 pages have a graphic touch. Could you provide an approximate budget range for supporting the project? Please include one budget with 3 simple infographics and 2 simple maps, plus a separate budget without those items. Thank you!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because we can reuse the template from our last submission, maps, infographics, and similar elements may not be necessary. That could mean fewer work hours and a total below $7800—excellent!

ambiguity.description: Whether custom maps and infographics remain in scope is unresolved pending review of the reusable prior template and the released RFP.
